name: ADJOURNED
tagline: A workflow tool for fraud lawyers: case summaries, recommended actions, AI calls and drafted documents.

awards: Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan

problem: Fraud lawyers manage dozens of cases and spend much of their time on busywork, the team says.
solution: Summarises cases and recommends actions that learn from feedback, handles AI calls and emails, and drafts work product from client data, with a swipe interface.
demo_moment: Team-described: swipe through cases and accept an action.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Tender for Lawyers Sponsored By Morgan & Morgan” among 112 submissions.
Learns from the lawyer's accept and reject choices.

lessons: Feedback loops make suggestions improve during use.
